macros.name: texttwcal
macros.doc: The macro \texttwcal typesets its argument in the twcal font.

macros.name: twcal
macros.doc: The command \twcal changes the current font family to twcal and the encoding to OT1.

macros.name: twcallogo
macros.doc: The command \twcallogo typesets the logo for the twcal font as defined by the author of the font.
